Method: owner answered single-select questions in a recorder question; option texts drafted by the recorder; not a personal signature

Basis.Reviews: Codex review on GitHub PR #112: R1 FAIL (5 P0, 1 P1), R2 no findings (treated as PASS); results archived in .codex-coordination/outbox/TASK_PHASE2_ROUTE_B_C03_V8_DESIGN_R{1,2}_CROSS_MODEL_REVIEW_RESULT.md

Decisions.Effect: two phases: V8-A (record contracts, pure validator, CLI wrapper, record builder, tests) now; V8-B (signatures, trusted time, anti-replay) deferred
the builder pre-fills only mechanical fields; every judgment item is answered by the reviewer one item at a time and transcribed verbatim; the validator lists every unmet rule

tests are based on R3 annex A counterexamples; V8 design R2 adopted; implementation of V8-A may start on a feature branch and goes through tests, PR review and owner decision before any run on real records

Limitations: V8-A cannot prove that records are true; it checks only consistency and rules
until V8-B, record contemporaneity, waiting time, model provenance and cross-call replay rely on the reviewer
